text_blocks.snippet: In Mississippi, the main taxes taken out of a paycheck are federal income tax, Social Security tax, and Medicare tax. Mississippi also has a state income tax, which is a flat 5% on all income above $10,000. Local income taxes are not applicable in Mississippi.

Social Security Tax: A flat 6.2% of your gross income.
Medicare Tax: A flat 1.45% of your gross income.
Mississippi Income Tax: 5% on income above $10,000.
State Unemployment Tax: New employers pay 1.0%, while experienced employers pay between 0% and 5.4%.
